title: Integrated operator environments becoming more relevant

decisionLogic.whatChanged: OEM and supplier discussions increasingly move toward integrated operator-environment solutions.
decisionLogic.whyItMatters: GRAMMER may need to evolve from component positioning toward broader operator-environment system offers.
decisionLogic.whatCouldHappenNext: Integrated operator-environment requirements may become visible in offroad programmes within the next 6-24 months.

uncertainty.openGap: Customer validation and willingness-to-pay evidence is still incomplete.

scenarios.likely: Integrated operator-environment requirements appear in additional offroad customer programmes.
scenarios.possible: OEMs begin requesting system-level cockpit or operator-environment proposals instead of standalone component offers.
scenarios.earlyWarning: New sourcing activity or competitor partnership activity appears around integrated cabin, HMI or operator-environment systems.

title: Automation changes operator role and cockpit expectations

decisionLogic.whatChanged: Automation and operator-assistance developments continue to expand.
decisionLogic.whyItMatters: Customer evaluation criteria may increasingly include intelligent operator-environment capabilities.
decisionLogic.whatCouldHappenNext: Automation requirements could influence cockpit architecture discussions.

decision.recommendedAction: Track customer requirements and innovation signals.

uncertainty.openGap: Customer adoption timing and technology maturity remain unclear.

scenarios.likely: Automation-adjacent cockpit and operator-assistance expectations become part of selected customer discussions.
scenarios.possible: R&D and Innovation need to define use cases for smart controls, ADAS and operator-assistance features.
scenarios.earlyWarning: A strategic customer or competitor publicly connects automation with operator-environment redesign.

title: Material handling automation creates account-specific opportunity potential

decisionLogic.whatChanged: Material handling automation signals continue to accumulate.
decisionLogic.whyItMatters: Several strategic accounts may require differentiated operator-environment solutions.
decisionLogic.whatCouldHappenNext: Account-specific opportunities may emerge within KION and Jungheinrich programmes.

decision.recommendedAction: Validate customer roadmaps and account opportunities.

uncertainty.openGap: Programme timing and customer investment priorities need validation.

scenarios.likely: Account-specific opportunities emerge around material-handling automation and operator-environment concepts.
scenarios.possible: KION, Jungheinrich or comparable accounts request more connected or assisted operator-environment concepts.
scenarios.earlyWarning: New programme notes, sourcing signals or customer roadmap updates indicate higher automation-related demand.
